# Champion pack

Text you can adapt to tell colleagues about NDL PubSec MCP. Keep the statement of what it is not.

NDL PubSec MCP is an independent prototype. It is not a government service and is not endorsed by any government department.

## In one sentence

NDL PubSec MCP lets an AI assistant search data.gov.uk and check metadata against the UK Cross-Government Metadata Exchange Model, using read-only tools.

## Intranet or blog post

> **Check your metadata before you publish it**
>
> If you publish data to data.gov.uk, you can now check a record against the UK Cross-Government Metadata Exchange Model in your browser, with nothing to install: paste the record and see what is missing. Analysts can also connect it to an AI assistant to search the catalogue and see what a record lacks. It is an independent prototype, not a government service, and it only reads. Try it at https://cyberdudeuk.github.io/ndl-pubsec-mcp/ and tell the maintainer what you think through the contact form.

## Team message

> Quick one: there's a free checker that shows what a data.gov.uk record is missing against xGov MEM. Paste a record, get a list. Nothing leaves your browser. https://cyberdudeuk.github.io/ndl-pubsec-mcp/#checker

## What to say it is not

- Not a government service, and not endorsed by any government department.
- It does not change any catalogue or store what you ask.
- An assistant can still make mistakes: check the source.
